title: Said Aloud, Read Different: Cross-Modal Instability in Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.27135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used in speech-first assistants that must interpret spoken queries and produce visually grounded decisions. Yet it remains unclear whether semantically equivalent queries yield consistent judgments across modality (text vs. speech) and language (English vs. Arabic). We introduce a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark spanning 10,150 culturally grounded images from 18 MENA countries, where each image is paired with one supported statement and two plausible but unsupported alternatives. We define contrastive instability as the conditional rate at which a model fails to resolve all statements within a triplet, isolating fragmented reasoning from complete failure. Evaluating recent multimodal models under text and speech in English and Arabic, we find that modality and language shifts introduce substantial triplet-level inconsistencies that are not fully captured by ag

translated_title: 大声说出，读法不同：多模态模型中的跨模态不稳定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27135v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多模态基础模型越来越多地用于语音优先的助手，这些助手必须解释口语查询并产生基于视觉的决策。然而，目前尚不清楚语义等价的查询在模态（文本与语音）和语言（英语与阿拉伯语）之间是否产生一致的判断。我们引入了一个语音增强的视觉接地对比三元组基准，涵盖来自18个中东和北非国家的10,150张文化接地图像，每张图像配有一个支持性陈述和两个看似合理但不支持的替代陈述。我们将对比不稳定性定义为模型在三元组内未能解决所有陈述的条件率，从而将碎片化推理与完全失败区分开来。在英语和阿拉伯语的文本和语音条件下评估近期多模态模型，我们发现模态和语言转换引入了显著的三元组级不一致性，而这些不一致性并未被聚合指标完全捕捉。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种语音增强的视觉接地对比三元组基准，揭示多模态模型在文本与语音、英语与阿拉伯语之间的跨模态和跨语言转换中，存在显著的三元组级判断不一致性，且未被聚合指标充分反映。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark, revealing significant triplet-level judgment inconsistencies in multimodal models across text-speech and English-Arabic shifts that are not fully captured by aggregate metrics.
